avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce pasireotide levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Hypericum perforatum
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction decreases pasireotide plasma concentrations

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase pasireotide exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; limit concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition; limited clinical evidence
caution_supplements.action: Monitor glucose and symptoms; counsel on use

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase pasireotide levels
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid grapefruit consumption during therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay pasireotide absorption and onset of action
caution_foods.action: Take injections as directed; meal timing with tablets not established

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood glucose closely as pasireotide may impair glucose tolerance. Watch for QT prolongation risk if combined with other QT-prolonging agents; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
